title: Post-restructure polish: help, levels, contrast guard, news, search, pricing

acceptance.text: 1. Help page feedback CTA uses bg-action / hover:bg-action-hover instead of bg-leaf, preserving size/shape (min-h-12).
2. Help FAQ details/summary hides native marker (list-none + webkit-details-marker hidden) and displays a themed chevron that rotates on open.
3. Levels readiness panel renders a truthful neutral empty state with no giant em-dash or fake 0% when no mock-exam sessions exist, keeping the CTA.

4. theme-contrast.regression.test.ts scans all app/**/*.tsx for element-level solid bg-accent + text-white/text-surface co-occurrence (allowlisting frozen magazine/**), and all true positives (share/[token], search-client, subscription-settings-client) are migrated to bg-action text-white.

5. /news card component renders source/difficulty/read badges cleanly in the card body (zero overlap with NHK NEWS image graphics or fallback banner in light/dark) and uses non-cropping image framing (object-contain on themed bg-paper) so baked-in NHK corner logos are never half-cut.

6. /search does not clip N5 beside TÌM KIẾM GẦN ĐÂY: mount-time autofocus does not pop open SearchDropdown over the filter bar, SearchDropdown spans full form width when opened, and chip/filter rows wrap cleanly.

7. /pricing free card renders a localized guest/learner start-learning CTA (vi/en/ja), and image_search_daily renders non-redundant Tìm ảnh: 5/ngày (Image searches: 5/day, 画像検索: 5/日) keeping numbers identical.

8. Shell loading investigated and bounded: LearnerAppFrame/AuthShell already render static header/footer immediately on SSR without waiting on session/data; 1-3s skeletons stem from 25+ client-fetched pages requiring full SSR data-flow rework, so item 8 is documented and SKIPPED.

spec.expected_behavior: 1) /help CTA uses bg-action/hover:bg-action-hover; 2) /help FAQ hides native marker with rotating themed chevron; 3) /levels readiness renders clean neutral empty state without giant em-dash or fake 0%; 4) element-level app/**/*.tsx contrast guard passes with all 4 true positives migrated to bg-action text-white (magazine/** allowlisted as frozen); 5) /news badges render in card body with dark-safe tokens and thumbnail uses object-contain on bg-paper so corner logos are never cropped or overlapped; 6) /search suppresses mount-time dropdown auto-open, anchors opened dropdown to full form width, and wraps filter/JLPT chip rows cleanly; 7) /pricing free card has localized vi/en/ja CTA and non-redundant Tìm ảnh: 5/ngày; 8) Shell loading root cause documented in evidence and explicitly SKIPPED without forcing a cross-cutting rewrite.
spec.observed_behavior: 1) /help feedback CTA uses off-palette bg-leaf; 2) /help FAQ <details>/<summary> renders raw native marker without chevron; 3) /levels readiness empty state shows oversized em-dash above noSessions; 4) theme-contrast regression test misses multi-line/var/text-surface bg-accent pairings leaving 4 WCAG AA failures (share/[token] x2, search-client, subscription-settings-client); 5) /news card overlays translucent blue NHK Easy badge onto NHK NEWS graphics and object-cover crops baked-in corner logos; 6) /search autofocus opens SearchDropdown inside flex-1 leaving N5 clipped at right edge of TÌM KIẾM GẦN ĐÂY; 7) /pricing free card has no CTA and image_search_daily repeats per-day wording (Tìm ảnh mỗi ngày: 5/ngày); 8) Shell loading investigated: LearnerAppFrame/AuthShell already render static header/footer immediately on SSR; 1-3s skeletons stem from 25+ client-fetched pages requiring full SSR data-flow rework, so item 8 is SKIPPED.

red_targets.test: learner help page > uses the primary action token on the feedback CTA and replaces the native FAQ marker with a rotating themed chevron
LevelsClient > renders a truthful neutral readiness empty state without an oversized dash or fake 0% when no sessions are completed
WEB-451 element-level bg-accent contrast guard across all app/**/*.tsx > forbids same-element solid bg-accent with white or light-white surface text across every app/**/*.tsx
NHK regression > renders news card badges in the card body without overlapping thumbnail graphics and avoids cropping corner logos
SearchClient recent searches and JLPT chip layout (WEB-451) > does not auto-open SearchDropdown over the N1-N5 filter bar on mount and anchors opened dropdown to full form width
PricingClient contracts > avoids redundant per-day wording on image_search_daily while keeping the exact quota numbers
PricingClient contracts > renders a localized CTA on the free plan card for guests and non-current learners
